## Review packet

- Project: Agent Safety / Safety Judge / Benchmark Contamination
- GitHub username:
- Intended PR or fork URL:

## Declaration

- [ ] I made the decisions myself rather than copying model suggestions.
- [ ] I used “I am unsure” where evidence was insufficient.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private data, email addresses, or host paths.
- [ ] I understand that a valid review does not prove production safety.

Do not attach review exports containing private information to an issue. Submit
the export through a pull request using `HUMAN_REVIEW_CONTRIBUTING.md`.
